first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing is the most direct response to competitor entry pricing and has inherited evidence of acquisition and revenue lift among price-sensitive SMBs. Verify its durability, qualification, and margin/retention effects before committing; verify onboarding as the competing explanation for weakening self-serve conversion. Use a guarded test because sustainable qualified revenue—not top-of-funnel acquisition alone—is the objective.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by verified evidence of higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%). Promotional pricing is ruled out for the sustainable-revenue objective because its verified retention loss (-12%) indicates weak downstream value despite short-term qualified-revenue lift. The experiment should measure qualified revenue and retention by cohort, since the inherited onboarding result validates leading and retention outcomes but not long-term qualified revenue directly.
